messages.subject: Reporting problems.
parts:
Dear Eric,

Have a good day. Recently, I had downloaded Distance 6.2 Release 1 software and as completely new to this software, I am facing problems. Started through Users manual, since then, I tried to understand the things completely. I have coordinates (Lat/Long) from a starting point to end point with Distance between the two coordinates and 4 observed data of various items observed between the coordinates. The data was imported from Excel successfully. While going through the steps, there it shows error and the value 0  was modified to -1. Again and again going through the steps, it shows error. Completely fed up with these errors. Kindly help me in this matter and if possible please post some pictorial steps to overcome this problem. 

Awaiting for your positive response.

Cheers.

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Reporting problems.
parts:
Pratysh

I suggest in addition to reading the Users Guide, that you also open several of the sample projects that are located in the subdirectory:

My Documents\My Distance Projects\Sample Projects

Study the data tab of these projects.  They will show how to organise your data to be understood by Distance.

Rather than providing coordinates of end points of a transect, you should provide the length of the transect; this is a measure of survey effort, required by Distance.  Unclear what you were changing from 0 to -1.

Have a look at a question I answered on 22Apr16 that seems related to your question, follow this link

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/distance-sampling/caBuOrqJO2A
